name: pi-leash
description: A Pi extension for controlling ACP-compatible coding agents as subagents

scripts.clean: node --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', '.test-dist']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:test-fixtures && vitest run --project integration
